card.name: The ending of "half-lives" after a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "ives" in "half-lives" after a number such as 3, 5 or 3 to 5. It appears in text about waiting after an interacting drug is stopped.

modes.description: Half-lives used to time restarting a drug or reaching steady state.
modes.example: Steady-state serum digoxin concentrations will be achieved in approximately five half-l<<ives>> of the drug for the individual patient.
